jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1533905&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelors degree (minimum requirement) in any relevant discipline from a reputed university. Only candidates who have already graduated will be considered. Additional Requirements Freshers are encouraged to apply. CORE COMPETENCIES Capability to support the planning and coordination of Junctions programs, including Incurator (incubation) and the School of Entrepreneurship (SoE). Ability to assist with secondary research, case documentation, and briefs for Junctions R&D and Research Fellowship activities. Ability to coordinate communication with founders, mentors, and partner organizations across Junctions entrepreneurial ecosystem. Ability to support documentation for Junctions Intellectual Property (IP) and Compliance & Investment Readiness portfolios. Capability to help organize workshops, cohort sessions, pitch events, and other Junction activities. Ability to contribute content for Junctions Blogs & Case Lab (cases, podcasts, teaching notes). Excellent competency in using MS Office and Google Workspace for documentation and reporting. Perfect command of both English and Bangla, in written and verbal communication. Responsibilities & Context ABOUT US: iSocial is a policy-driven, for-profit social enterprise delivering impact through data-driven insights, strategic advocacy, and innovative digital solutions. iSocial operates through three Strategic Business Units: DataSense – Research, policy, and data analytics arm. Junction Bangladesh – Venture studio and ecosystem-building unit supporting startups and enterprises. iSkill – A digital platform transforming TVET institutions through blended learning. JOB OVERVIEW Junction Bangladesh is looking for a motivated Intern to support its entrepreneurship development work. The selected candidate will work directly within Junctions core team, assisting across incubation, research, and ecosystem-building activities. The role demands coordination, curiosity, and a genuine interest in entrepreneurship and innovation. INTERNSHIP TERMS This is a 4-month internship, extendable based on mutual discussion between the intern and management. Interns who perform well may be offered a full-time position within the organization, subject to the managements discretion and business needs. JOB NATURE AND MODALITY Full-time (Sunday through Thursday) CORE DUTY STATION The interns core duty and reporting line will be within Junction Bangladesh. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Case Management Compliance Coordination Documentation Google Sheets Compensation & Other Benefits Monthly remuneration of BDT 10,000 Subsidized lunch. Compensatory leave for working extra hours and weekends or holidays. Professional exposure to national and international development and ecosystem initiatives. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka

In compliance with the applicable circulars/instructions of Bangladesh Bank, successful completion of the required Banking Professional Examination (JAIBB/AIBB, as applicable) is mandatory for consideration of an offer at the next job grade. Responsibilities & Context Manage and coordinate day-to-day HR & Administrative activities of the factory. Maintain and update HR & Administrative records, registers, and documentation (Factory & Govt. Related) accurately and timely. Monitor manpower requirements, recruitment, attendance, and payroll processing. Ensure adequate, capable, and efficient manpower deployment across departments. Maintain a positive working environment and ensure smooth factory operations. Coordinate with government and non-government offices as required. Assist in implementing HR policies, training programs, and employee development initiatives. Coordinate administrative support services, bill verification, and timely payment recommendations. Manage and monitor factory canteen operations, ensuring food quality, hygiene, and employee satisfaction. Coordinate company vehicle management and related administrative matters. Perform any other duties assigned by management. jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1534925&fc.source_content: Requirements Education Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Public Administration, or another relevant discipline from a recognized institution. Preferred: Training or certification in Administration, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Procurement, or Office Management will be an advantage. Experience At least 1 year The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): NGO Additional Requirements Experience – Essential Minimum 1 years of relevant experience in administration, logistics, operations, office management, or related fields. Experience supporting administrative documentation and filing. Experience in logistics coordination, asset management, or inventory management. Experience using Microsoft Office applications. Experience maintaining records and tracking documents. Desirable Previous experience working with NGOs, INGOs, or humanitarian organizations. Experience working in a healthcare facility, PHCC, hospital, Field Hospital, or humanitarian health programme. Previous experience in the Rohingya Response or other humanitarian settings. Experience supporting emergency or field operations. Experience working in a multidisciplinary and multicultural environment. Skills & Competencies Technical Skills Basic knowledge of administration and logistics procedures. Understanding of filing and record management. Basic knowledge of asset and inventory management. Understanding of procurement request and supply follow-up processes. Basic understanding of transport and facility coordination. Good knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook. Planning & Organizational Skills Good organizational and time management skills. Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities. Strong attention to detail. Ability to follow instructions and organizational procedures. Good follow-up and coordination skills. Ability to work under pressure. Communication & Interpersonal Skills Good communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to coordinate effectively with different teams. Good documentation skills. Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary and multicultural environment. Good written and spoken English and Bangla. Other Competencies High level of integrity, accountability, and professionalism. Strong attention to accuracy and detail. Ability to maintain confidentiality. Commitment to responsible use of organizational resources. Ability to work in a challenging and fast-paced humanitarian environment. Cultural sensitivity and respect for affected populations. Flexibility and willingness to support emergency operations. Working Conditions The position will be based at a Primary Health Care Centre (PHCC) in the Rohingya Response, Cox’s Bazar. The position holder will provide administrative and logistical support to PHCC operations. The role may involve coordination with multiple clinical and support teams. The position holder may be required to move between PHCC facilities and other programme locations based on operational needs. The role involves working in a challenging and fast-paced humanitarian healthcare environment. The position holder may be required to support activities outside regular working hours during emergencies or critical operational requirements. Responsibilities & Context Position Summary The Assistant Officer – Admin & Logistics will provide administrative and logistical support to ensure the smooth and efficient operation of the Primary Health Care Centre (PHCC) in the Rohingya Response, Cox’s Bazar. The position holder will support day-to-day administrative activities, logistics coordination, documentation, filing, asset and inventory management, transport arrangements, procurement follow-up, facility maintenance, and other operational requirements. The Assistant Officer – Admin & Logistics will work under the supervision of the Senior Officer – Admin & Logistics and closely coordinate with the Clinical Coordinator, Medical Officer Lead, Medical Warehouse, Pharmacy, Laboratory, Nursing, Midwifery, IPC, Surveillance, Finance, HR, Procurement, Supply Chain, Security, WASH, and other relevant teams to support uninterrupted and effective PHCC service delivery. Duty Station: Camp 5 & 21, Cox’s Bazar Reports to: Senior Officer Admin & Logistics Accountable to: Deputy Project Coordinator KEY AREAS OF ACCOUNTABILITY: Administrative Support Provide day-to-day administrative support to PHCC operations. Assist in preparing letters, notices, memos, meeting minutes, and other official documents. Maintain proper filing systems for administrative and operational documents. Support the preparation and distribution of internal communications. Maintain and organize electronic and physical records. Assist in scheduling meetings and coordinating administrative arrangements. Support follow-up of routine administrative action points. Receive and distribute official documents and correspondence as assigned. Maintain confidentiality of organizational and staff information. Meeting, Training & Event Support Support logistical arrangements for meetings, trainings, workshops, and orientations. Prepare meeting rooms and ensure required materials are available. Assist with participant registration and attendance records. Support preparation and distribution of meeting materials. Assist in documenting meeting minutes and action points when assigned. Coordinate refreshments and other approved logistical arrangements. Support follow-up on agreed action points. Ensure training and meeting venues are properly arranged. Logistics Coordination Support Provide day-to-day logistical support for PHCC activities. Assist in coordinating the movement and delivery of approved supplies and materials. Follow up on routine logistical requests. Coordinate with relevant teams regarding operational requirements. Support timely delivery of non-medical supplies to designated locations. Assist in tracking pending logistical requests. Report delays or logistical constraints to the Senior Officer – Admin & Logistics. Support logistics arrangements for programme and emergency activities. Procurement Request & Follow-up Support Assist PHCC teams in preparing procurement requests according to organizational procedures. Ensure requests contain required specifications and supporting documents. Maintain a tracking record of submitted procurement requests. Follow up with Procurement and Supply Chain teams regarding request status. Communicate updates on approved requests to relevant teams. Support receiving and checking of general supplies and equipment. Maintain relevant procurement-related records. Escalate delayed or urgent requests to the supervisor. Asset Management Support Assist in maintaining accurate PHCC asset records. Support asset tagging and registration. Maintain asset movement and handover records. Assist in periodic physical verification of assets. Monitor the location and condition of assigned assets. Report damaged, missing, or lost assets promptly. Support asset handover and return processes. Maintain supporting documentation related to assets. Assist during asset audits and verification exercises. General Store & Non-Medical Supply Management Assist in maintaining stock records for general office and non-medical supplies. Monitor the availability of stationery, office materials, cleaning supplies, and other approved non-medical items. Support proper storage and organization of supplies. Assist in receiving and issuing general supplies. Maintain stock issue and receipt records. Support periodic physical stock counts. Report shortages, damaged items, and stock discrepancies. Support timely replenishment of essential non-medical supplies. Transport & Movement Support Assist in coordinating transport requests for PHCC staff and activities. Maintain transport request records. Support communication with drivers and transport focal persons. Assist with scheduling approved staff movement and field visits. Follow up on vehicle availability. Communicate transport schedules to relevant staff. Support emergency transportation arrangements when assigned. Report transport constraints or delays to the supervisor. Facility & Office Support Support routine monitoring of PHCC offices and common operational areas. Identify basic maintenance and repair requirements. Report facility-related concerns to the Senior Officer – Admin & Logistics. Assist in following up on maintenance and repair requests. Monitor basic office and facility requirements, including furniture and equipment. Support arrangements for workspace and office facilities. Assist in maintaining a clean, organized, and functional working environment. Report damaged or unsafe equipment and facilities promptly. Utilities & Operational Services Support monitoring of essential operational services, including: o Electricity and backup power. o Water supply. o Lighting. o Ventilation. o Communication and internet services, where applicable. Report service interruptions or technical problems promptly. Assist in following up with relevant teams for restoration of services. Maintain relevant operational records when assigned. Support contingency arrangements during utility disruptions. Documentation & Record Management Maintain accurate and organized administrative and logistics records. Support proper filing of: o Procurement requests. o Asset records. o General stock records. o Transport requests. o Maintenance requests. o Meeting records. o Visitor records. o Administrative correspondence. Maintain both electronic and physical filing systems. Ensure documents are properly labelled and accessible to authorized personnel. Maintain confidentiality and security of organizational documents. Visitor & Reception Support Support the administrative management of official visitors. Maintain visitor records where applicable. Assist with arrangements for official meetings and visits. Provide basic administrative support during monitoring and official visits. Coordinate logistical arrangements for visitors when assigned. Ensure relevant staff are informed about scheduled official visits. Support appropriate access procedures for visitors. Coordination with PHCC Teams Work closely with the Senior Officer – Admin & Logistics and other PHCC teams. Coordinate with Pharmacy, Medical Warehouse, Laboratory, Nursing, Midwifery, IPC, Surveillance, and other teams regarding routine administrative and logistics requirements. Liaise with HR, Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Security, and other support departments. Support communication and follow-up between PHCC and support teams. Participate in relevant meetings when assigned. Communicate operational challenges and delays to the supervisor. Safety, Security & Health Support Follow organizational health, safety, and security procedures. Identify and report workplace hazards and unsafe conditions. Support basic facility safety measures. Ensure emergency exits and access routes are kept clear. Support the maintenance of safety notices and emergency information. Report security concerns promptly. Coordinate with Security and relevant teams when assigned. Support emergency preparedness activities. Support logistics arrangements during disease outbreaks, fires, natural disasters, mass casualty incidents, and other emergencies. Assist with emergency transportation and movement arrangements when assigned. Support continuity of essential administrative and logistical services. Participate in emergency preparedness activities and drills. Remain flexible to undertake additional responsibilities during emergency response. jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1535072&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor’s degree (BBA/MBA) with 2+ years in tactical/urgent procurement. Additional Requirements Pre-requisite to apply: Proficiency in SAP/Oracle ERP systems and strong MS Excel skills for managing procurement workflows. Strong vendor/supplier management, market analysis, commercial awareness, and a cost-conscious, analytical mindset. Proven negotiation, high-pressure execution for urgent/multiple requirements, thorough documentation, and steady follow-up. Strong communication skills paired with high integrity, confidentiality, and strict adherence to ethical procurement practices. Responsibilities & Context SQUARE Pharmaceuticals PLC., the flagship company of SQUARE Group and certified by major international pharmaceutical regulatory authorities, is holding the 1st position in the pharmaceutical industry among all national and multinational companies of Bangladesh since 1985. SQUARE Pharmaceuticals PLC. has become a global player starting its operation in Kenya. Right now we are looking for smart, energetic and result oriented team members, who will share with us our pride and support our continuous growth. If you think you have what it takes to be a member of SQUARE, do not wait to apply as: Officer, Local Procurement, Supply Chain Management Work Station: Corpoprate Headquaters Major Duties and Responsibilities: Fast-track urgent procurement for IT, engineering, and office supplies to maintain uninterrupted operations. Build a reliable supplier network, gather multi-quote bids, and negotiate optimal prices, warranties, and delivery terms. Track market trends, drive cost savings, and convert repetitive spot buys into structured, long-term supply contracts. Partner with Engineering, IT, Production, and Warehouse teams to verify technical specs and validate emergency justifications. Issue Purchase Orders (POs), build audit-ready documentation, and enforce strict adherence to company SCM policy. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills ERP Systems Logistics Management Supply Chain Management Compensation & Other Benefits Salary Range: Attractive remuneration package will be offered Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka

raw_source_fields.age: ncy, Advertising Technology (AdTech) Startup Additional Requirements

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1535103&fc.source_content:
Requirements Experience At least 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Advertising Agency, Advertising Technology (AdTech) Startup Additional Requirements Age At least 20 years Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in Media Buying / Performance Marketing. Previous experience managing at least USD 500/day in paid advertising is required. Strong hands-on experience with Meta Ads and Google Ads. Experience with TikTok and YouTube Ads will be preferred. Strong understanding of lead generation, conversion funnels, retargeting and campaign scaling. Practical knowledge of Meta Pixel, CAPI, GA4, GTM and conversion tracking. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently and take ownership of campaign performance. Most importantly, you must be able to show real previous work and results . We want to know which companies or brands you have worked with, how much budget you managed and what results you achieved. Performance Bonus / KPI This is a result-driven role . Performance Bonus/KPI will be based on measurable results such as: Lead Quality Cost Per Qualified Lead Cost Per Acquisition / Conversion Conversion Rate ROAS Overall Advertising Efficiency The goal is not simply to spend the budget. The goal is to generate better business results from every advertising dollar spent. Responsibilities & Context About the Role Deyal Ltd. is looking for an experienced Media Buyer & Performance Marketing Specialist to take ownership of our paid advertising across Facebook, Instagram, Google, YouTube, TikTok and other relevant platforms . Our daily advertising budget can reach USD 1,000 , so we need someone who is already comfortable managing significant ad spend and making decisions based on data. We are not looking for someone who only knows how to set up campaigns. We need someone who can understand what is working, identify where money is being wasted, test new strategies and scale campaigns that produce results. What You’ll Do Plan, launch, optimize and scale paid advertising campaigns. Manage daily ad budgets of up to USD 1,000 . Build lead generation, conversion and retargeting campaigns. Research audiences, competitors and new opportunities. Test different audiences, offers, creatives and campaign strategies. Monitor CPL, CPA, conversion rate, ROAS and lead quality. Identify underperforming campaigns and take corrective action quickly. Scale successful campaigns while maintaining efficiency. Work closely with the Creative Team and provide direction on what creatives, hooks and offers should be tested. Maintain accurate tracking through Meta Pixel, CAPI, GA4, GTM and other relevant tools. Prepare clear performance reports and recommend what should be tested or improved next. Skills & Expertise Digital Media Buying facebook ads Google Ads Lead Generation Media Buying Media Planning/ Media Buying YouTube Marketing Other Relevant Skills Marketing Performance Marketing Compensation & Other Benefits Tour allowance,Performance bonus Festival Bonus: 1 Salary Review: Yearly Performance Bonus/KPI: Based on actual results Final salary will depend on experience, previous advertising budget managed and proven campaign results. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

Responsibilities & Context
Job Context
ENaturalMart is a growing ecommerce marketplace focused on natural and authentic products. We are looking for an energetic, smart, and target-oriented Business Development Officer (BDO) to support our business expansion.
The selected candidate will be responsible for identifying potential vendors and business opportunities, onboarding new vendors, developing relationships, and supporting the growth of ENaturalMart's marketplace.
Job Responsibilities
Vendor Acquisition & Business Development
Identify and approach potential vendors, manufacturers, farmers, producers, brands, and suppliers of natural products.
Conduct vendor outreach through phone calls, email, social media, online research, and field visits when required.
Explain ENaturalMart's marketplace model, benefits, commercial terms, and onboarding process to potential vendors.
Negotiate pricing, commission, payment terms, product availability, and other business conditions with vendors.
Maintain strong and professional relationships with existing and prospective vendors.
Follow up regularly with potential vendors until successful onboarding.
Identify new product categories and business opportunities for ENaturalMart.
Research competitors, suppliers, markets, and emerging natural-product trends.
Vendor Onboarding & Product Coordination
Collect vendor information, product details, pricing, product images, documents, and other required
information.
Coordinate with the operations and technical team to complete vendor onboarding.
Ensure product information is accurate and complete before listing.
Monitor vendor responsiveness, product availability, pricing, and service quality.
Maintain an updated vendor database and follow-up records.
Business Communication & Negotiation
Communicate professionally with vendors in both Bangla and English.
Conduct business negotiations confidently and professionally.
Build long-term relationships with vendors and business partners.
Handle vendor questions and coordinate internally to resolve issues.
Reporting & Office Work
Prepare daily and weekly business development reports.
Maintain vendor databases using MS Excel / Google Sheets.
Prepare presentations, documents, emails, and business proposals using MS Office.
Maintain records of leads, follow-ups, meetings, negotiations, and conversions.
Internet & AI Utilization
Use the internet effectively for vendor research, market research, competitor analysis, and lead generation.
Use AI tools such as ChatGPT and other relevant AI tools to improve research, communication, reporting, data analysis, and productivity.
Demonstrate willingness to learn and adopt new digital and AI-powered tools
Compensation & Other Benefits
Performance-based incentives.
Career growth opportunities.
Opportunity to work with a growing ecommerce and natural-products marketplace.
Opportunity to develop practical skills in ecommerce, business development, digital tools, and AI.

Work at office

This position requires active business development and vendor communication. Candidates should be comfortable making calls, conducting follow-ups, communicating with business owners/suppliers, negotiating commercial terms, and taking ownership of assigned targets.

raw_source_fields.education: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) Bachelor of Business Studies (BBS)
raw_source_fields.age: 22 to 32 years Responsibilities & Context Company Description:- Bangladesh Psychiatric Care Ltd. (BPCL) is the first comprehensive psychiatric consultation center in Bangladesh, offering international standard mental health services under one roof. With a mission to deliver one-stop solutions for all mental health needs, BPCL addresses a wide range of psychiatric disorders, psychological challenges, and psycho-social issues. The experienced team of globally recognized and emerging psychiatrists, along with expert psychotherapists, provides world-class treatment, management, and rehabilitation services. Located in Dhaka, BPCL emphasizes quality care for a better quality of life and is committed to raising the standard of mental health care in the region. Job Summary:- The Jr. Business Development Executive will be responsible for supporting the growth and expansion initiatives of Bangladesh Psychiatric Care Ltd. by developing strategic relationships, promoting healthcare services, identifying business opportunities, and assisting in marketing and client engagement activities. The incumbent will work closely with internal teams to enhance organizational visibility and maintain strong relationships with corporate clients, healthcare professionals, institutions, and stakeholders.

Responsibilities & Context Managing overall office administration and ensuring smooth daily operations. Maintaining proper books of accounts, vouchers, bills, invoices, and supporting documents. Handling cash, bank deposits, withdrawals, and cheque-related activities. Managing petty cash and preparing regular petty cash statements. jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1534042&fc.title: Transaction Service Officer, Retail Distribution, Retail Banking

raw_source_fields.age: 24 to 32 years Responsibilities & Context Execution of Transaction: Cash receive from customer and payment to customer with proper checking and counting of physical cash through manual and machine support (counting machine). Posting of all transactions in core banking software as per delegation. Execute Islami Banking transactions (receipt/payment) through IB software (Ababil) and core software. Receiving clearing & collection cheques and maintaining clearing/collection cheque inward/outward register. Process clearing cheque through related software (MICR & BACH). Act as clearing house representative of branch. Physically present at clearing house for local clearing at Sonali Bank for rural branches. Remittance to local Feeding bank (Sonali bank as representative of Bangladesh Bank) and other bank branches maintaining process guidelines. Assistance to chief teller in collection, Selling & purchasing of prize bond and preservation of stamps for internal use. FCY currency transaction. Collection of utility bills (PDB/WASA etc). Collection of various fees of BRTA through separate BRTA software and reporting including posting at core software at day end. Maintenance and exchange of coins and mutilated notes at cash counters. Sorting of cash manually as per process for onward payment and remittance to feeding branch/Bangladesh bank. Active support to chief teller for cash management at branch ATM & CDM. Support to various offsite collection (ie; CR Booth at Airport) booths. Cash/Prize Bond/Stamp collection and delivery to various branches as per their requisition/requirement by the Feeding branches. Act as Chief of Transaction Service in case of leave of Chief of Transaction Service. Ensure Customer Service: Ensuring responses to customer queries at cash counter regarding their accounts. Ensuring fasts possible transaction with accuracy to maintain appropriate queue management (EQM). Ensure SLA is maintained for each and every transaction services provided to customer. Ensure faster service to large customers of Corporate and Commercial and SME division. Ensure service to collection accounts (GP/Bkash/Alico etc) of Cash Management through related separate software. Ensuring Compliance & Regulatory Requirements: Check all instruments for validity and acceptability and decline transaction that involves false or confusing information. Checking and confirmation of all cheque placed in the counter through various related software (MICR) and phone calls before payment. Inform any suspicious transaction to the upper management of the branch immediately. Inform customer and CS team for TP update requirement of the customers. Completing proper KYC at counter for walk-in customers transactions needs. Cross checking of daily cash transactions and delivery of daily vouchers to CSM for final tally for submission to branch operation member. Daily reconciliation of all transactions. Ensure smooth service for External, Internal & Statutory Audit Inspection time to count physical cash. Promote, Educate and Advise Customers on Products & Services of the Bank: Keep updated regularly regarding features/requirements/charges of the products and services of the bank. Keep all relevant forms, brochures and information to educate customers for promoting bank’s product and services. Assist customer to complete any application. Achievement of Business Targets and Revenue Generation: Maintaining Acquisition of new business through effective customer communication and relationship and meet business targets as per given KPI. Preparation of loan and credit card applications and follow up with approval with related department (Credit & Collection). Cross selling all the bank's products. Realization of online charges & fees as per SOC. Proper usage and control of stationary and equipment to control the cost of the branch. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Cash Handling Customer Service Islamic Banking Regulatory Compliance

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1534554&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Human Resource Management, Management or relevant discipline. Additional Requirements Age 24 to 32 years Only Male Experience Requirements: 1–3 years of experience in HR/Admin. Experience in recruitment, attendance, leave management and payroll support will be preferred. Freshers with strong interest in HR may also be considered. Additional Requirements: Good knowledge of MS Excel and MS Office. Good Bangla and English communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle employee matters professionally. Strong organizational and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks. Responsibilities & Context Manage end-to-end recruitment activities including CV screening, interview coordination, selection and onboarding. Maintain employee personal files, attendance and leave records. Prepare and maintain monthly salary sheets and provide payroll-related support. Handle employee queries and provide necessary HR support. Prepare HR letters, notices, office notes and other HR-related documents. Maintain and update HR records and databases. Assist in employee confirmation, increment, final settlement and other HR processes. Support HR/Admin activities and ensure smooth day-to-day HR operations. Assist in implementing HR policies, procedures and employee engagement/organizational development initiatives. Perform other HR and administrative tasks as assigned by management. Undertake any other responsibilities or tasks assigned by the management from time to time. Working hours: 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM. Candidates should have a responsible and committed mindset with the intention to work for at least one year. Skills & Expertise Bangla and English typing Human Resource Management Microsoft Office Recruitment & Selection Other Relevant Skills Administrative Support Employee Management HR Policy Compensation & Other Benefits Salary Review: Yearly Festival Bonus: 2 Two-time snacks and tea provided during office hours. Professional and supportive work environment. Opportunities for professional learning and career development. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Dhaka (Khilgaon)

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1535169&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Management, Business Administration, Textile, Industrial Engineering, or a relevant discipline. Experience 2 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Buying House, Garments Additional Requirements Age 25 to 28 years Only Male Strong reconciliation and quantitative analysis skills. Good knowledge of MS Excel/Office, particularly formulas, Pivot Tables, and data analysis. Basic understanding of dyeing, washing, dyes, and chemical consumption. Experience with OPEX and Lean Management will be an advantage. Minimum 3 years of relevant professional experience, preferably in the RMG/textile manufacturing sector. Strong understanding of reconciliation, quantitative analysis, and operational data. Responsibilities & Context Reconcile and trace garment quantities from cutting through shipment across different stages of production. Review production records and identify discrepancies between different production stages. Perform quantitative analysis and reconciliation of production-related data. Monitor the utilization and consumption of dyes and chemicals in Dyeing and Washing operations from an internal audit perspective. Compare actual consumption with relevant production requirements and identify unusual variations. Monitor non-moving and slow-moving inventory and prepare reports highlighting potential wastage or accumulation. Analyze inventory data and support management in minimizing inventory-related losses. Prepare regular audit findings, analytical reports, and management summaries. Maintain proper documentation and supporting records for audit observations. Work with production and operational teams to understand process gaps and support corrective actions. Assist in identifying opportunities for cost control, waste reduction, and process improvement. Support implementation and monitoring of OPEX and Lean Management practices where applicable. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Internal Audit Data Reconciliation Inventory Analysis Waste Reduction Cost control Compensation & Other Benefits Salary Review: Yearly Festival Bonus: 2 Other benefits as per company policy Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Narayanganj

Requirements Education Bachelor of Business Studies (BBS) Master of Business Studies (MBS) Experience At least 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Hospital Additional Requirements Age 28 to 35 years Only Male Experience in departmental coordination & surgical items procurement is highly preferred Strong negotiation and vendor management skills· Knowledge of hospital consumables and departmental requirements· Proficiency in MS Excel and ERP systems· Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple departmental demands Responsibilities & Context Handle purchase requisitions (PR), collect quotations (RFQ), prepare comparative statements (CS), and issue purchase orders (PO) Manage procurement for OT, ICU/CCU/NICU, Pharmacy, Laboratory, and General Store Ensure timely supply of medical and non-medical items as per departmental requirements Procure surgical and medical consumables while ensuring quality and expiry compliance Identify and manage vendors; negotiate price, delivery, and payment terms Maintain optimum stock levels and coordinate with store/pharmacy to prevent stock-out or overstock Maintain proper procurement documentation (PR, RFQ, CS, PO, GRN, invoices) and update ERP/HIS Handle emergency procurement for critical cases Process supplier bills and verify invoices against Purchase Orders (PO), Goods Receipt Notes (GRN), and supporting documents. Coordinate with Accounts & Finance Department for timely bill submission, payment processing, and vendor reconciliation. Follow up on supplier payments and resolve invoice discrepancies or payment-related issues. Maintain accurate records of supplier invoices, payment schedules, and outstanding liabilities Skills & Expertise Procurement Quality Assurance Strategic Sourcing Vendor Management Other Relevant Skills Supply Chain Management Compensation & Other Benefits Provident fund,Gratuity Salary Review: Yearly Festival Bonus: 2 Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Dhaka (Ashulia)
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

raw_source_fields.age: At least 25 years

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1534954&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) Bachelor of Social Science (BSS) Additional Requirements Age At least 25 years Experience: Minimum one year of relevant work experience, Having a PGD in SCM from any reputed education alliance will be an added advantage. Key Requirement: Strong negotiation skills to secure cost-effective supplier contracts while maintaining product quality and internal operational demands and external market vendors. Preference: Cost Savings Track Record Knowledge of specific spend areas, raw materials/electric and electronic items/goods/food item/grocery and etc, or direct/indirect procurement. A history of successfully building backup supplier networks to prevent severe inventory shortages. Agro based industry Required competencies: Strong organizational & Communication skills both English and Bangla. Proficiency in MS Office and email correspondence. Additional Requirement : Age preferably 25years+ Willingness to travel frequently all over Bangladesh. Responsibilities & Context Vendor Identification: Finding, evaluating, and onboarding new suppliers that meet company standards. Price Negotiation: Negotiating commercial terms, payment windows, and volume discounts with vendors. Purchase Order Management: Creating, tracking, and verifying Purchase Orders (POs) through internal ERP systems. Contract Monitoring: Ensuring suppliers comply with agreed-upon Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Cross-Functional Collaboration: Aligning with finance for payments, logistics for delivery, and warehousing for stock counts. Invoice Reconciliation: Resolving price or quantity discrepancies between invoices, POs, and goods received notes. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills SCM Cost reduction Supply Chain Management Purchase/ Procurement Procurement and Logistics Compensation & Other Benefits Employee benefits: Free Lunch Mobile bill. TA/DA Festival Bonus Yearly salary review Job Location : Head office/all over Bangladesh. Remuneration : Negotiable/ as per company policy. Employment Status Full Time Job Location Anywhere in Bangladesh
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

Responsibilities & Context Job Location: Rampur, Burichang, Cumilla-3531 Workplace: Work at Factory / Office About the Role: ARS Footwear Limited is seeking two proactive and detail-oriented Junior HR Officers to join our factory operations. The ideal candidates will support the HR Manager in daily HR, administrative, and compliance activities, ensuring a smooth and efficient workplace for all employees. Key Responsibilities: HR Operations & Administration: Monitor daily attendance, manage employee leave and payroll. Maintain, update, and organize all employee records, personnel files, and documentation to ensure readiness at all times. Assist HR manager to draft standard HR correspondence, including Appointment, Increment, Warning, and Relieving letters. Prepare routine reports for management regarding HR activities. Assist the management team in hosting employee training, performance appraisals, grievance handling, and disciplinary actions in line with company policy. Help implement HR policies, procedures, and the Code of Conduct across the factory. Compliance & Problem Solving: Assist in ensuring organizational compliance with Bangladesh labor laws, health & safety regulations, and internal policies. Stay updated with changes in labor laws to support the HR departments compliance efforts. Apply problem-solving and conflict management skills to assist in resolving minor workplace disputes. Strictly follow instructions from the HR Manager to execute HR, Admin, and Compliance work effectively. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Recruitment & Selection HRIS/ HR Database Management HR and Administration HR and compliance Compensation & Other Benefits Salary Range: 20,000 - 25,000 BDT per month. raw_source_fields.age: At least 18 years Responsibilities & Context বিভিন্ন ছোট ও মাঝারি ব্যবসা প্রতিষ্ঠান (যেমন: ফ্যাশন হাউস, কসমেটিকস দোকান, মুদি দোকান, ফার্মেসি, স্যানিটারি দোকান ইত্যাদি) পরিদর্শন করা। দোকানের মালিক বা দায়িত্বপ্রাপ্ত ব্যক্তির সাথে সরাসরি যোগাযোগ করে Takar Hisab অ্যাকাউন্টিং অ্যাপ সম্পর্কে সহজ ও বোধগম্য ভাষায় ধারণা দেওয়া। নতুন গ্রাহকদের তাৎক্ষণিকভাবে অ্যাপে নিবন্ধন (Account Creation) করতে সহায়তা করা এবং প্রথম হিসাব এন্ট্রি করে দেওয়া। দোকান মালিকদের বিক্রয়, বাকি হিসাব, আয়-ব্যয় এবং বিভিন্ন রিপোর্ট ব্যবহারের পদ্ধতি বুঝিয়ে দেওয়া। সম্ভাব্য ও নতুন গ্রাহকদের প্রয়োজনীয় তথ্য সংগ্রহ করে প্রতিদিনের কার্যক্রমের রিপোর্ট জমা দেওয়া। নিবন্ধিত গ্রাহকদের সাথে নিয়মিত WhatsApp বা ফোনের মাধ্যমে যোগাযোগ করে প্রয়োজনীয় সহায়তা প্রদান এবং অ্যাপ ব্যবহারে উৎসাহিত করা। প্রতিদিন নির্ধারিত সংখ্যক নতুন গ্রাহক নিবন্ধন (Sales Target) সম্পন্ন করা এবং মাসিক বিক্রয় লক্ষ্যমাত্রা অর্জনে কাজ করা। প্রতিদিন নির্দিষ্ট সংখ্যক দোকান পরিদর্শন, সম্ভাব্য গ্রাহকদের সাথে সাক্ষাৎ এবং লিড তৈরি করে বিক্রয় নিশ্চিত করার জন্য নিয়মিত ফলো-আপ করা। Skills & Expertise Marketing and Sales Retail Sales Sales & Marketing Sales Target Achievement Salesman Other Relevant Skills Field Visit Sales & Marketing Strategic Planning Strategic Sales Planning

এই চাকরির জন্য বিজ্ঞাপনদাতা ব্যাক্তি/প্রতিষ্ঠান আপনার কাছ থেকে কোন অর্থ চাইলে কিংবা নিয়োগ প্রক্রিয়া চলাকালীন কোন প্রকার হয়রানিমূলক (শারীরিক/মানসিক) আচরণ করলে অতিসত্ত্বর আমাদেরকে জানান অথবা জবটি রিপোর্ট করুন। চাকরি পাওয়ার জন্য কোন ব্যাক্তি/প্রতিষ্ঠানকে অর্থ প্রদান করবেন না। চাকরিকালীন কোন প্রকার হয়রানির (শারীরিক/মানসিক) সম্ভাবনা থাকলে সেখানে জয়েন করবেন না। কোন প্রকার অর্থ লেনদেন বা নিয়োগদাতা কর্তৃক হয়রানির দায়িত্ব বিডিজবস বহন করবে না।

Requirements Education Graduate in any discipline (Hospitality, Business, IT preferred); IELTS; A or O level background is desired but not mandatory Experience 1 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Property Management & Preservation Services Additional Requirements 1 to 3 years of experience in hospitality, property management, operations coordination, customer support, or virtual coordination. Freshers welcome. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English (IELTS desired, not required) Strong organizational, analytical, and multitasking capabilities Ability to work independently, make sound decisions, and manage competing priorities Proficiency with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and online management tools Experience with property rental software platforms preferred Must have a personal computer with reliable internet and a work-from-home setup Availability to work in either 7:00 PM–3:00 AM OR 2:00 AM–10:00 AM (Bangladesh time) shift aligning with the North American Time Zone. Availability to respond to time-sensitive operational matters when required Responsibilities & Context Vacancy: Multiple Job Context: Headroom Group, a fast-growing architecture firm with a global footprint, is seeking a dedicated Online Operations Coordinator (Part-Time) to support its tenant and property management division, in collaboration with the North American partner firm PROFIXXY. This is a fully remote, work-from-home position ideal for detail-oriented, tech-savvy candidates comfortable coordinating with international clients and guests. Job Responsibilities: Manage guest and tenant communications, bookings, cancellations, and reservation changes Deliver timely guest support and coordinate resolution of issues and emergencies Schedule, oversee, and coordinate property cleaning, maintenance, and turnover activities Monitor calendars, operational tasks, and service-provider performance Conduct remote quality-control reviews using photos, reports, and camera security footage Investigate guest incidents, damages, and policy violations; maintain supporting documentation Prepare and organize insurance claim evidence and operational records Escalate urgent matters when required and drive issues through to resolution Maintain accurate reports, logs, and operational documentation Liaise with foreign clients remotely from Bangladesh Job Location: Remote; Work From Home anywhere Employment Status: Part-time (15 working days per month), Remote Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Customer Support Hospitality Management Operational Management Property Management Compensation & Other Benefits Salary: Competitive, negotiable based on experience and qualifications. Range BDT 12,000 to BDT 15,000 per month (Part Time / Pro Rata basis) Compensation & Other Benefits: Long-term job stability, growth potential, detailed training provided, and festival bonus. Employment Status Part Time Job Location Anywhere in Bangladesh

Stay updated with the latest digital media, SEO, social media, and web development trends . Work closely with the editorial and management teams to meet daily content and digital requirements. raw_source_fields.age: 20 to 35 years Page Moderator → Team Leder→ Digital Marketing / E-commerce Career ভালো পারফরম্যান্স, Sales Skill, Customer Handling এবং Digital Platform সম্পর্কে দক্ষতার ভিত্তিতে ধাপে ধাপে Page Manager ও Digital Marketing-এর বিভিন্ন দায়িত্বে কাজ করার সুযোগ থাকবে। যারা শুধু চাকরি নয়, Sales, E-commerce ও Digital Marketing-এ দীর্ঘমেয়াদি ক্যারিয়ার গড়তে চান , তাদের জন্য এটি একটি ভালো শেখার ও Growth-এর সুযোগ। Responsibilities & Context Facebook, Messenger, WhatsApp ও ফোন কলে গ্রাহকের মেসেজ ও কলের দ্রুত, ভদ্র ও প্রফেশনালভাবে উত্তর দেওয়া। গ্রাহকের প্রয়োজন ও বাজেট বুঝে সঠিক পণ্য ও অফার সম্পর্কে পরামর্শ দেওয়া এবং সফলভাবে সেলস কনফার্ম করা। গ্রাহকের নাম, মোবাইল নম্বর, ঠিকানা ও অর্ডার ডিটেইলস সঠিকভাবে সংগ্রহ ও প্রসেস করা। সম্ভাব্য (Potential) ও পুরোনো কাস্টমারদের নিয়মিত Follow-up করা এবং প্রাসঙ্গিক অফার/নতুন পণ্য সম্পর্কে জানানো। Delivery Team-এর সঙ্গে সমন্বয় করে সময়মতো অর্ডার প্রসেস, পার্সেল পাঠানো ও Delivery Tracking নিশ্চিত করা। পণ্য ডেলিভারির পর কাস্টমারের Feedback নেওয়া এবং Return, Exchange বা অন্যান্য সমস্যার সমাধানে প্রয়োজনীয় সহযোগিতা করা। প্রতিষ্ঠানের নির্ধারিত দৈনিক ও মাসিক Sales Target অর্জনে কাজ করা। দৈনিক ও সাপ্তাহিক Order, Sales ও Follow-up Report সঠিকভাবে আপডেট রাখা। Skills & Expertise Digital Marketing (Social Media Marketing) Marketing Online Marketing Sales Sales & Marketing Salesman Other Relevant Skills Customer Relationship Social Media Management Customer Service

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1535526&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Masters MBA / M.Com in Accounting / Finance or CA (CC) completed / partially completed from a reputed public or private university. (Special preference will be given to candidates with professional degrees or specialized training in VAT, Taxation, or Inventory/Supply Chain Management). Additional Requirements Age 28 to 40 years Minimum 5 (five) years of practical hands-on experience in Accounts, Finance, VAT management, and Inventory/Warehouse operations in a reputed corporate house, trading, or manufacturing company. Note: Freshers or candidates with less than 5 years of experience are strictly not allowed to apply. Proven leadership experience in supervising inventory or warehouse staff. Sound command over computerized accounting software, ERP inventory modules, and advanced MS Excel. In-depth practical knowledge of VAT laws, Mushak 6.3, inventory valuation methods, return submission, and handling local VAT office matters. High integrity, strong interpersonal skills, and the ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced growing business environment. Responsibilities & Context Job Context: We are a fast-growing commercial business enterprise. To manage our expanding financial operations, robust compliance, rigorous VAT management, and comprehensive inventory control, we are looking for a seasoned, proactive, and experienced Executive / Senior Executive - Accounts, VAT & Inventory. The ideal candidate will take charge of comprehensive financial reporting, full-cycle bank management, end-to-end VAT compliance (including direct liaison with VAT authorities), and overall inventory management along with supervising the inventory/warehouse team. If you have a strong background in commercial accounting, VAT handling, and supply chain inventory control, we welcome you to join our growing team in Mirpur, Dhaka. Key Responsibilities: Inventory Management & Team Supervision: Inventory Control & Monitoring: Oversee end-to-end inventory management, stock movement, receiving, dispatch, and periodic physical stock verification. Team Leadership: Manage, guide, and supervise the inventory and store-level personnel working under this department to ensure operational efficiency. Stock Reconciliation: Conduct regular reconciliation between physical stock, system records (ERP/software), and general ledger accounts to prevent shrinkage, discrepancies, or losses. Supply Chain Alignment: Coordinate closely with sales, procurement, and accounts teams to maintain optimum stock levels and streamline inventory flow for our growing business. Comprehensive Accounts & Financial Reporting: Financial Reporting: Prepare, analyze, and present accurate monthly, quarterly, and yearly financial reports (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow) to management. Sales & Ledger Entries: Systematic entry and management of daily sales, purchases, expenses, and general ledger maintenance. Bank Reconciliation & Management: Comprehensive handling of all banking operations, including daily bank transactions, fund transfers, monthly Bank Reconciliation Statements (BRS), and physical/digital bank deposits. Cash Management: Rigorous day-to-day cash management, physical cash counting, systematic cash segregation, and strict financial controls to mitigate risk. Advanced VAT & Regulatory Compliance: Mushak 6.3 & VAT Management: Expert management, generation, and maintenance of Mushak 6.3, purchase-sale registers, and other statutory documents in alignment with inventory records as per the current VAT and SD Act. VAT Authority Liaison: Maintain a strong, professional working relationship and smooth communication with VAT circle officials, commissioners, and regulatory bodies for hassle-free compliance and resolution of assessments. Import & LC Operations: Handle accounts and VAT-related procedures for import shipments, assist in opening and managing Letters of Credit (LC), and manage related banking/customs documentation. Regulatory Updates: Keep the management updated regarding changes in tax, VAT, and financial compliance laws. Growing Business Support: Partner with management to streamline financial and inventory processes, strengthen internal controls, and support commercial scaling as a growing enterprise. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Accounts and Finance Financial Reporting VAT and Tax Letter Of Credit Compensation & Other Benefits Salary & Other Benefits (বেতন ও সুযোগ-সুবিধা): Salary: Negotiable (যোগ্যতার ভিত্তিতে আকর্ষণীয় ও আলোচনা সাপেক্ষে নির্ধারিত হবে) Salary Payment System: Paid on a regular monthly basis. Festival Bonus: 2 (Two) major festival bonuses. Salary Review: Yearly increment based on performance. Probation Period: 6 (Six) months. Other Benefits: Mobile bill / SIM allowance. Evening daily snacks facility at the office. Friendly, energetic work culture with immense career growth potential in a growing business. Requirements Education Masters MBA / M.Com in Accounting / Finance or CA (CC) completed / partially completed from a reputed public or private university. (Special preference will be given to candidates with professional degrees or specialized training in VAT, Taxation, or Inventory/Supply Chain Management). Additional Requirements Age 28 to 40 years Minimum 5 (five) years of practical hands-on experience in Accounts, Finance, VAT management, and Inventory/Warehouse operations in a reputed corporate house, trading, or manufacturing company. Note: Freshers or candidates with less than 5 years of experience are strictly not allowed to apply. Proven leadership experience in supervising inventory or warehouse staff. Sound command over computerized accounting software, ERP inventory modules, and advanced MS Excel. In-depth practical knowledge of VAT laws, Mushak 6.3, inventory valuation methods, return submission, and handling local VAT office matters. High integrity, strong interpersonal skills, and the ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced growing business environment. Responsibilities & Context Job Context: We are a fast-growing commercial business enterprise. To manage our expanding financial operations, robust compliance, rigorous VAT management, and comprehensive inventory control, we are looking for a seasoned, proactive, and experienced Executive / Senior Executive - Accounts, VAT & Inventory. The ideal candidate will take charge of comprehensive financial reporting, full-cycle bank management, end-to-end VAT compliance (including direct liaison with VAT authorities), and overall inventory management along with supervising the inventory/warehouse team. If you have a strong background in commercial accounting, VAT handling, and supply chain inventory control, we welcome you to join our growing team in Mirpur, Dhaka. Key Responsibilities: Inventory Management & Team Supervision: Inventory Control & Monitoring: Oversee end-to-end inventory management, stock movement, receiving, dispatch, and periodic physical stock verification. Team Leadership: Manage, guide, and supervise the inventory and store-level personnel working under this department to ensure operational efficiency. Stock Reconciliation: Conduct regular reconciliation between physical stock, system records (ERP/software), and general ledger accounts to prevent shrinkage, discrepancies, or losses. Supply Chain Alignment: Coordinate closely with sales, procurement, and accounts teams to maintain optimum stock levels and streamline inventory flow for our growing business. Comprehensive Accounts & Financial Reporting: Financial Reporting: Prepare, analyze, and present accurate monthly, quarterly, and yearly financial reports (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow) to management. Sales & Ledger Entries: Systematic entry and management of daily sales, purchases, expenses, and general ledger maintenance. Bank Reconciliation & Management: Comprehensive handling of all banking operations, including daily bank transactions, fund transfers, monthly Bank Reconciliation Statements (BRS), and physical/digital bank deposits. Cash Management: Rigorous day-to-day cash management, physical cash counting, systematic cash segregation, and strict financial controls to mitigate risk. Advanced VAT & Regulatory Compliance: Mushak 6.3 & VAT Management: Expert management, generation, and maintenance of Mushak 6.3, purchase-sale registers, and other statutory documents in alignment with inventory records as per the current VAT and SD Act. VAT Authority Liaison: Maintain a strong, professional working relationship and smooth communication with VAT circle officials, commissioners, and regulatory bodies for hassle-free compliance and resolution of assessments. Import & LC Operations: Handle accounts and VAT-related procedures for import shipments, assist in opening and managing Letters of Credit (LC), and manage related banking/customs documentation. Regulatory Updates: Keep the management updated regarding changes in tax, VAT, and financial compliance laws. Growing Business Support: Partner with management to streamline financial and inventory processes, strengthen internal controls, and support commercial scaling as a growing enterprise. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Accounts and Finance Financial Reporting VAT and Tax Letter Of Credit Compensation & Other Benefits Salary & Other Benefits (বেতন ও সুযোগ-সুবিধা): Salary: Negotiable (যোগ্যতার ভিত্তিতে আকর্ষণীয় ও আলোচনা সাপেক্ষে নির্ধারিত হবে) Salary Payment System: Paid on a regular monthly basis. Festival Bonus: 2 (Two) major festival bonuses. Salary Review: Yearly increment based on performance. Probation Period: 6 (Six) months. Other Benefits: Mobile bill / SIM allowance. Evening daily snacks facility at the office. Friendly, energetic work culture with immense career growth potential in a growing business. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka (Mirpur)

নিয়মিত Promotional Content তৈরি করা। শিক্ষার্থীদের Certificate, Academic Documents ইত্যাদি Apostille করার জন্য আবেদন ও প্রসেসিং করা। শিক্ষার্থীদের ID Card, Certificate ও অন্যান্য প্রয়োজনীয় ডকুমেন্ট Translation-এর কাজ করা। Visa processing ও admission-related প্রয়োজনীয় ডকুমেন্ট প্রস্তুতিতে সহযোগিতা করা। শিক্ষার্থীদের ডকুমেন্ট সংগ্রহ, যাচাই ও প্রয়োজন অনুযায়ী সংশোধনের জন্য সংশ্লিষ্ট টিমের সঙ্গে সমন্বয় করা। Social Media Content ও Marketing-related অন্যান্য দায়িত্ব পালন করা। অফিসের প্রয়োজন অনুযায়ী Student Visa Processing ও Documentation-এর অন্যান্য কাজ করা। শিক্ষাগত যোগ্যতা: ন্যূনতম HSC / Bachelor’s Degree। শিক্ষাগত যোগ্যতার পাশাপাশি প্রাসঙ্গিক কাজের দক্ষতাকে অগ্রাধিকার দেওয়া হবে। প্রয়োজনীয় দক্ষতা: Adobe Photoshop / Illustrator / Canva-তে কাজের দক্ষতা। Adobe Premiere Pro / CapCut / After Effects বা যেকোনো ভালো Video Editing Software-এর ব্যবহার জানা। AI Video Generation Tools সম্পর্কে বাস্তব ধারণা থাকা। Basic English ও Computer Skills থাকতে হবে। Microsoft Word, Excel ও PDF-related কাজ জানা থাকতে হবে। Document Formatting, Scanning, Printing ও Online Application-এর কাজে দক্ষ হতে হবে। নতুন Software/AI Tools দ্রুত শেখার আগ্রহ থাকতে হবে। Student Visa ও Education Consultancy-related কাজ শেখার মানসিকতা থাকতে হবে। অভিজ্ঞতা: Graphic Design, Video Editing, Digital Marketing অথবা Education Consultancy/Student Visa Documentation-এর কাজে অভিজ্ঞ প্রার্থীদের অগ্রাধিকার দেওয়া হবে। তবে দক্ষতা থাকলে Fresher-রাও আবেদন করতে পারবেন। ব্যক্তিগত গুণাবলি: দায়িত্বশীল ও সময়নিষ্ঠ হতে হবে। শিক্ষার্থীদের সঙ্গে ভদ্র ও পেশাদার আচরণ করতে হবে। চাপের মধ্যে কাজ করার মানসিকতা থাকতে হবে। দ্রুত শেখার আগ্রহ ও সমস্যা সমাধানের দক্ষতা থাকতে হবে। Creative ও Proactive হতে হবে। কর্মস্থল: মধ্য বাড্ডা, পোস্ট অফিস বাস স্ট্যান্ড, সিটিজেন ব্যাংকের উপরে, ৫ম তলা, ঢাকা-১২১২। বেতন: আলোচনা সাপেক্ষে দক্ষতা ও অভিজ্ঞতার ভিত্তিতে আকর্ষণীয় বেতন নির্ধারণ করা হবে। আবেদন: আগ্রহী প্রার্থীদের তাদের CV/Resume এবং পূর্বের Graphic Design/Video Editing কাজের Portfolio/Work Sample সহ আবেদন করতে হবে। South Korea Student Visa ও বিভিন্ন শিক্ষা কার্যক্রমের জন্য আকর্ষণীয় Poster/Banner ডিজাইন করা।
Facebook, YouTube, TikTok ও অন্যান্য সোশ্যাল মিডিয়ার জন্য Video Editing করা।
প্রয়োজন অনুযায়ী AI দিয়ে Promotional Video/Reels তৈরি করা।
Student Visa, University Admission ও বিভিন্ন Intake-এর জন্য নিয়মিত Promotional Content তৈরি করা।
শিক্ষার্থীদের Certificate, Academic Documents ইত্যাদি Apostille করার জন্য আবেদন ও প্রসেসিং করা।
শিক্ষার্থীদের ID Card, Certificate ও অন্যান্য প্রয়োজনীয় ডকুমেন্ট Translation-এর কাজ করা।
Visa processing ও admission-related প্রয়োজনীয় ডকুমেন্ট প্রস্তুতিতে সহযোগিতা করা।
শিক্ষার্থীদের ডকুমেন্ট সংগ্রহ, যাচাই ও প্রয়োজন অনুযায়ী সংশোধনের জন্য সংশ্লিষ্ট টিমের সঙ্গে সমন্বয় করা।
Social Media Content ও Marketing-related অন্যান্য দায়িত্ব পালন করা।
অফিসের প্রয়োজন অনুযায়ী Student Visa Processing ও Documentation-এর অন্যান্য কাজ করা।
শিক্ষাগত যোগ্যতা:
ন্যূনতম HSC / Bachelor’s Degree।
শিক্ষাগত যোগ্যতার পাশাপাশি প্রাসঙ্গিক কাজের দক্ষতাকে অগ্রাধিকার দেওয়া হবে।
প্রয়োজনীয় দক্ষতা:
Adobe Photoshop / Illustrator / Canva-তে কাজের দক্ষতা।
Adobe Premiere Pro / CapCut / After Effects বা যেকোনো ভালো Video Editing Software-এর ব্যবহার জানা।
AI Video Generation Tools সম্পর্কে বাস্তব ধারণা থাকা।
Basic English ও Computer Skills থাকতে হবে।
Microsoft Word, Excel ও PDF-related কাজ জানা থাকতে হবে।
Document Formatting, Scanning, Printing ও Online Application-এর কাজে দক্ষ হতে হবে।
নতুন Software/AI Tools দ্রুত শেখার আগ্রহ থাকতে হবে।
Student Visa ও Education Consultancy-related কাজ শেখার মানসিকতা থাকতে হবে।
অভিজ্ঞতা:
Graphic Design, Video Editing, Digital Marketing অথবা Education Consultancy/Student Visa Documentation-এর কাজে অভিজ্ঞ প্রার্থীদের অগ্রাধিকার দেওয়া হবে।
তবে দক্ষতা থাকলে Fresher-রাও আবেদন করতে পারবেন।

দায়িত্বশীল ও সময়নিষ্ঠ হতে হবে।
শিক্ষার্থীদের সঙ্গে ভদ্র ও পেশাদার আচরণ করতে হবে।
চাপের মধ্যে কাজ করার মানসিকতা থাকতে হবে।
দ্রুত শেখার আগ্রহ ও সমস্যা সমাধানের দক্ষতা থাকতে হবে।
Creative ও Proactive হতে হবে।
কর্মস্থল:
মধ্য বাড্ডা, পোস্ট অফিস বাস স্ট্যান্ড, সিটিজেন ব্যাংকের উপরে, ৫ম তলা, ঢাকা-১২১২।
বেতন:
আলোচনা সাপেক্ষে
দক্ষতা ও অভিজ্ঞতার ভিত্তিতে আকর্ষণীয় বেতন নির্ধারণ করা হবে।
আবেদন:
আগ্রহী প্রার্থীদের তাদের CV/Resume এবং পূর্বের Graphic Design/Video Editing কাজের Portfolio/Work Sample সহ আবেদন করতে হবে।

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1535754&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Additional Requirements Age 21 to 26 years Responsibilities & Context Assist the admissions team in counselling prospective students and parents regarding study abroad opportunities, admission requirements, and application procedures. Support the processing of student applications, including document collection, data entry, and follow-ups to ensure timely submissions. Maintain and update student records, CRM systems, and admission-related databases accurately. Coordinate with counsellors and partner universities to track application status and communicate updates to students. Support marketing activities such as promoting services through social media, phone calls, emails, and in-office engagement. Assist in planning and executing marketing campaigns, seminars, education fairs, and promotional events at Banani and Dhanmondi offices. Handle front-desk queries and provide basic information to walk-in students and guardians in a professional manner. Conduct market research on universities, courses, scholarships, and competitor activities to support marketing strategies. Help create basic marketing content such as flyers, posters, social media captions, and student success posts. Collaborate with the marketing team to generate leads and convert inquiries into potential applicants. Perform other administrative and coordination tasks as assigned by the admissions or marketing supervisors. Skills & Expertise Computer Literacy Other Relevant Skills CRM Marketing Visa Processing Compensation & Other Benefits There is an opportunity to secure a full-time permanent job after successful completion of the internship period. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka (Banani, Dhanmondi)
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

Requirements Education Master of Commerce (MCom) in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration CA (CC) certification will be preferred. Experience 2 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Group of Companies, Spinning, Textile Additional Requirements Age 30 to 35 years Only Male Experience in Spinning Mills, manufacturing, garments/textile, trading, or corporate organizations will be preferred. Candidates with practical experience in ERP-based auditing and financial transaction review will receive preference. Strong knowledge of accounting and internal audit procedures. Good understanding of internal control, risk management, and compliance . Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Word, and ERP software . Strong analytical and problem-solving ability. Excellent attention to detail. Good communication and report-writing skills. Ability to work independently and under pressure. Willingness to visit factories, warehouses, branches, and other business locations when required. High level of integrity, confidentiality, and professional ethics. Responsibilities & Context Conduct regular financial, operational, compliance, and management audits as per the approved audit plan. Review accounting records, vouchers, bills, invoices, payments, receipts, and supporting documents. Verify cash, bank transactions, inventory, fixed assets, procurement, production, payroll, and other operational activities . Review and verify transactions and reports maintained in the company's ERP system . Check whether transactions are properly authorized and comply with company policies, SOPs, and applicable laws and regulations. Conduct physical verification of inventory, raw materials, finished goods, accessories, spare parts, fixed assets, and other company properties. Review payroll, attendance, overtime, bonus, leave, and employee-related payments where applicable. Identify financial irregularities, process gaps, control weaknesses, wastage, and potential fraud risks. Conduct surprise inspections/audits when required by management. Prepare detailed audit working papers and maintain proper audit documentation. Prepare clear and concise Internal Audit Reports highlighting observations, risks, root causes, and recommendations. Assist in special audits, investigations, fraud reviews, and management assignments when required. Coordinate with Finance, Accounts, HR, Commercial, Procurement, Production, Store, IT, and other departments during audit assignments. Perform any other duties assigned by the Head of Internal Audit, Management, and Board of Directors. Skills & Expertise Audit Internal Audit Compensation & Other Benefits Salary Review: Yearly Festival Bonus: 2 Attractive salary package. Festival bonuses and other benefits as per company policy. Professional development and career growth opportunities. Other facilities as per organizational policy. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Dhaka

Requirements Education HSC Bachelor/Honors Masters Experience At least 1 year The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Immigration/Visa Processing, Travel Agency, Real Estate, Micro-Credit Additional Requirements Age 20 to 40 years Only Male Responsibilities & Context চাকরির দায়িত্বসমূহ বিদেশে জনশক্তি নিয়োগ ও ম্যানপাওয়ার সেবার জন্য মার্কেটিং কৌশল তৈরি ও বাস্তবায়ন করা। নতুন ব্যবসায়িক সুযোগ ও সম্ভাব্য ক্লায়েন্ট খুঁজে বের করা এবং ব্যবসায়িক সম্পর্ক তৈরি করা। বিদ্যমান ক্লায়েন্ট, ব্যবসায়িক অংশীদার ও সংশ্লিষ্ট ব্যক্তিদের সঙ্গে সুসম্পর্ক বজায় রাখা। বিদেশি নিয়োগকর্তা ও রিক্রুটমেন্ট পার্টনারদের সঙ্গে জনশক্তির চাহিদা নিয়ে নিয়মিত যোগাযোগ ও সমন্বয় করা। রিক্রুটমেন্ট সেবা ও চাকরির সুযোগ সম্ভাব্য প্রার্থী ও ক্লায়েন্টদের কাছে প্রচার করা। ক্লায়েন্ট ও সম্ভাব্য ব্যবসায়িক লিডের সঙ্গে নিয়মিত যোগাযোগ ও ফলোআপ করা। প্রয়োজন অনুযায়ী সম্ভাব্য ক্লায়েন্ট, প্রতিষ্ঠান ও সংশ্লিষ্ট সংস্থায় সরাসরি মার্কেটিং ভিজিট করা। মার্কেটিং রিপোর্ট, ক্লায়েন্ট আপডেট এবং ফলোআপ সংক্রান্ত তথ্য সংরক্ষণ ও প্রস্তুত করা। জনশক্তি নিয়োগের প্রয়োজনীয়তা অনুযায়ী রিক্রুটমেন্ট ও অপারেশন টিমের সঙ্গে সমন্বয় করা। ক্লায়েন্টের বিভিন্ন প্রশ্নের পেশাদারভাবে উত্তর দেওয়া এবং রিক্রুটমেন্ট সেবা সম্পর্কে সঠিক তথ্য প্রদান করা। বিদেশে জনশক্তি নিয়োগ খাতের বাজার পরিস্থিতি ও প্রতিযোগীদের কার্যক্রম পর্যবেক্ষণ করা। প্রতিষ্ঠানের নির্ধারিত মাসিক মার্কেটিং ও ব্যবসায়িক লক্ষ্যমাত্রা অর্জন করা। Skills & Expertise Cold Calling Communication and interpersonal skill Computer Literacy Telemarketing Compensation & Other Benefits Mobile bill,Performance bonus,Tour allowance Lunch Facilities: Full Subsidize Salary Review: Half Yearly Festival Bonus: 2 Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. বিদেশে জনশক্তি নিয়োগ ও ম্যানপাওয়ার সেবার জন্য মার্কেটিং কৌশল তৈরি ও বাস্তবায়ন করা।
নতুন ব্যবসায়িক সুযোগ ও সম্ভাব্য ক্লায়েন্ট খুঁজে বের করা এবং ব্যবসায়িক সম্পর্ক তৈরি করা।
বিদ্যমান ক্লায়েন্ট, ব্যবসায়িক অংশীদার ও সংশ্লিষ্ট ব্যক্তিদের সঙ্গে সুসম্পর্ক বজায় রাখা।
বিদেশি নিয়োগকর্তা ও রিক্রুটমেন্ট পার্টনারদের সঙ্গে জনশক্তির চাহিদা নিয়ে নিয়মিত যোগাযোগ ও সমন্বয় করা।
রিক্রুটমেন্ট সেবা ও চাকরির সুযোগ সম্ভাব্য প্রার্থী ও ক্লায়েন্টদের কাছে প্রচার করা।
ক্লায়েন্ট ও সম্ভাব্য ব্যবসায়িক লিডের সঙ্গে নিয়মিত যোগাযোগ ও ফলোআপ করা।
প্রয়োজন অনুযায়ী সম্ভাব্য ক্লায়েন্ট, প্রতিষ্ঠান ও সংশ্লিষ্ট সংস্থায় সরাসরি মার্কেটিং ভিজিট করা।
মার্কেটিং রিপোর্ট, ক্লায়েন্ট আপডেট এবং ফলোআপ সংক্রান্ত তথ্য সংরক্ষণ ও প্রস্তুত করা।
জনশক্তি নিয়োগের প্রয়োজনীয়তা অনুযায়ী রিক্রুটমেন্ট ও অপারেশন টিমের সঙ্গে সমন্বয় করা।
ক্লায়েন্টের বিভিন্ন প্রশ্নের পেশাদারভাবে উত্তর দেওয়া এবং রিক্রুটমেন্ট সেবা সম্পর্কে সঠিক তথ্য প্রদান করা।
বিদেশে জনশক্তি নিয়োগ খাতের বাজার পরিস্থিতি ও প্রতিযোগীদের কার্যক্রম পর্যবেক্ষণ করা।
প্রতিষ্ঠানের নির্ধারিত মাসিক মার্কেটিং ও ব্যবসায়িক লক্ষ্যমাত্রা অর্জন করা।

Requirements Education HSC Bachelor/Honors Masters Experience At least 1 year The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Immigration/Visa Processing, Travel Agency, Real Estate, Micro-Credit Additional Requirements Age 20 to 40 years Only Male Responsibilities & Context চাকরির দায়িত্বসমূহ বিদেশে জনশক্তি নিয়োগ ও ম্যানপাওয়ার সেবার জন্য মার্কেটিং কৌশল তৈরি ও বাস্তবায়ন করা। নতুন ব্যবসায়িক সুযোগ ও সম্ভাব্য ক্লায়েন্ট খুঁজে বের করা এবং ব্যবসায়িক সম্পর্ক তৈরি করা। বিদ্যমান ক্লায়েন্ট, ব্যবসায়িক অংশীদার ও সংশ্লিষ্ট ব্যক্তিদের সঙ্গে সুসম্পর্ক বজায় রাখা। বিদেশি নিয়োগকর্তা ও রিক্রুটমেন্ট পার্টনারদের সঙ্গে জনশক্তির চাহিদা নিয়ে নিয়মিত যোগাযোগ ও সমন্বয় করা। রিক্রুটমেন্ট সেবা ও চাকরির সুযোগ সম্ভাব্য প্রার্থী ও ক্লায়েন্টদের কাছে প্রচার করা। ক্লায়েন্ট ও সম্ভাব্য ব্যবসায়িক লিডের সঙ্গে নিয়মিত যোগাযোগ ও ফলোআপ করা। প্রয়োজন অনুযায়ী সম্ভাব্য ক্লায়েন্ট, প্রতিষ্ঠান ও সংশ্লিষ্ট সংস্থায় সরাসরি মার্কেটিং ভিজিট করা। মার্কেটিং রিপোর্ট, ক্লায়েন্ট আপডেট এবং ফলোআপ সংক্রান্ত তথ্য সংরক্ষণ ও প্রস্তুত করা। জনশক্তি নিয়োগের প্রয়োজনীয়তা অনুযায়ী রিক্রুটমেন্ট ও অপারেশন টিমের সঙ্গে সমন্বয় করা। ক্লায়েন্টের বিভিন্ন প্রশ্নের পেশাদারভাবে উত্তর দেওয়া এবং রিক্রুটমেন্ট সেবা সম্পর্কে সঠিক তথ্য প্রদান করা। বিদেশে জনশক্তি নিয়োগ খাতের বাজার পরিস্থিতি ও প্রতিযোগীদের কার্যক্রম পর্যবেক্ষণ করা। প্রতিষ্ঠানের নির্ধারিত মাসিক মার্কেটিং ও ব্যবসায়িক লক্ষ্যমাত্রা অর্জন করা। Skills & Expertise Cold Calling Communication and interpersonal skill Computer Literacy Telemarketing Compensation & Other Benefits Mobile bill,Performance bonus,Tour allowance Lunch Facilities: Full Subsidize Salary Review: Half Yearly Festival Bonus: 2 Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. raw_source_fields.age: 22 to 27 years Only Female অফিসের Front Desk পরিচালনা এবং দৈনন্দিন কার্যক্রম সুষ্ঠুভাবে পরিচালনা করা। আগত অতিথি, ক্লায়েন্ট ও ভিজিটরদের পেশাদার ও আন্তরিকভাবে অভ্যর্থনা জানানো এবং প্রয়োজনীয় তথ্য প্রদান করা। ফোন কল গ্রহণ করা, প্রয়োজন অনুযায়ী সংশ্লিষ্ট ব্যক্তি/বিভাগে কল Transfer করা এবং প্রয়োজনীয় বার্তা সংরক্ষণ করা। ভিজিটরদের তথ্য রেজিস্টার/Visitor Log-এ সঠিকভাবে সংরক্ষণ করা। অফিসে আগত চিঠি, কুরিয়ার, ডকুমেন্ট ও পার্সেল গ্রহণ এবং সংশ্লিষ্ট ব্যক্তি/বিভাগে পৌঁছে দেওয়া। অফিসের সাধারণ তথ্য, যোগাযোগের ঠিকানা ও প্রয়োজনীয় সেবা সম্পর্কে আগত ব্যক্তি ও ক্লায়েন্টদের সহযোগিতা করা। Meeting/Appointment সম্পর্কিত প্রয়োজনীয় Coordination ও Scheduling-এ সহযোগিতা করা। Front Desk-এর প্রয়োজনীয় Documents, Files ও Records সুশৃঙ্খলভাবে সংরক্ষণ করা। অফিসের দৈনন্দিন প্রশাসনিক কাজে প্রয়োজন অনুযায়ী HR & Admin Department-কে সহযোগিতা করা। অফিসের Professional বজায় রেখে সকলের সঙ্গে ভদ্র, মার্জিত ও দায়িত্বশীল আচরণ করা। প্রয়োজন অনুযায়ী অন্যান্য অফিসিয়াল ও প্রশাসনিক দায়িত্ব পালন করা। 💻 নিয়োগ প্রক্রিয়া প্রথম ধাপ: Google Meet-এর মাধ্যমে Online Viva অনুষ্ঠিত হবে। পরবর্তী ধাপ: Online Viva-তে নির্বাচিত প্রার্থীদের অফিসে সরাসরি Interview-এর জন্য আমন্ত্রণ জানানো হবে। 📩 আবেদন করুন 📧 Email: career@ onwarddevelopers.com 📞 Contact: 01963925366 Responsibilities & Context Freshers are encouraged to apply. Mirpur এলাকার প্রার্থীদের অগ্রাধিকার দেওয়া হবে। ভালো Communication ও Interpersonal Skills থাকতে হবে। Smart, Presentable, Polite ও Positive Attitude থাকতে হবে। Basic Computer Knowledge (MS Word, Excel, Email ইত্যাদি) থাকলে অগ্রাধিকার দেওয়া হবে। Skills & Expertise Front Desk Receptionist/ Front Desk
